entities.name: Guilherme Giovannoni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Guilherme Giovannoni is a Brazilian former professional basketball player. He played at the power forward position for several clubs in Brazil and Europe. Currently, he is a commentator on the National Basketball Association
and Novo Basquete Brasil for ESPN Brasil.
